newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber up on light buying, Japan's rise.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber up on light buying, Japan's rise.

text.p: Rubber futures closed marginally higher on Monday on the back of light buying for RSS3 rubber and in line with firmer Japanese prices, dealers said.
"Japan gave it a slight push up. There were also some local outfits engaged in a bit of buying for RSS3 for their commercial needs," a rubber trader here said.
"But it's still a soft market and this kind of rally in Japan has the ability to quickly run out of steam," one dealer said.
Tokyo's benchmark March contract rose 0.5 yen to settle at 133.0 while Kobe's March contract ended at 132.6 from yesterday's settlement price of 132.0 yen.
November RSS3 was seen at 122.50-123.50 U.S. cents a kg at around 0945 GMT from last Friday's settlement of 122.25 cents.
November RSS1 was indicated at 174.00-175.00 Singapore cents (US$1.23-$1.24) a kg from the previous 174.25 cents.
November TSR20 was seen at 171.50-173.50 Singapore cents (US$1.21-$1.23) a kg against the previous 171.25 cents.
